# CarSpa Marbella – LLM Context

> Quick-reference for AI assistants working on this codebase.

## Overview
Next.js 14 App Router website for a premium car detailing shop in Marbella, Spain. Services include wrapping, PPF, ceramic coating, paint correction, headlight tinting, chrome delete, boat treatment, and Tesla specialist work.

## Stack
- Next.js 14 (App Router, `src/app/`)
- TypeScript
- SCSS (one stylesheet per page/component in `src/styles/`)
- `next/image` via `<LoadingImage>` wrapper (`src/components/LoadingImage.tsx`)
- CDN helper: `src/lib/cdn.ts`
- Form backend: Formspark

## Directory Layout
```
src/app/           – route pages (wrapping/, ceramic/, ppf/, etc.)
src/components/    – shared React components
src/lib/cdn.ts     – builds CDN URLs with optional width/height
src/styles/        – SCSS files matching pages (wrapping.scss, ceramic.scss, …)
```

## Important Patterns

### Fill-mode images
Use `<LoadingImage fill sizes="..." style={{ objectFit: "cover" }} />` inside a container with:
- `position: relative`
- `aspect-ratio: 9 / 16` (or desired ratio)
- `.loading-image-container { position: absolute; inset: 0; }`

### Phone number
All occurrences: `+47 93 99 16 33`
Files:
- `Header.tsx` (tel link + display)
- `Footer.tsx` (tel link)
- `WhatsAppBubble.tsx` (WHATSAPP_NUMBER)
- `QuoteRequest.tsx` (whatsappNumber default prop)

### CDN images
`cdn(path, { width, height })` returns a Cloudinary URL with transformations. Define `MEDIA_SIZE` / `GALLERY_SIZE` constants per page.

## Common Tasks

| Task | Files |
|------|-------|
| Change phone number | Header, Footer, WhatsAppBubble, QuoteRequest |
| Add new service page | Create `src/app/<slug>/page.tsx`, add stylesheet in `src/styles/`, import style in page |
| Adjust media grid height | Change `aspect-ratio` in corresponding `.scss`, ensure LoadingImage uses `fill` + `objectFit: cover` |

## Dev Commands
```bash
npm run dev      # start local server (port 3000)
npm run build    # production build
npm start        # run production build locally
```
